text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka and I have come to the riverside to run.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What great weather. The sun is shining so bright—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Air Groove gave me some sunscreen the other day because she said my skin looked a little agitated.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I should go back home to get it. Sigh… If only the weather wasn't so nice, then I wouldn't need it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: But wait… If the weather were bad, then it wouldn't feel good to run anyway…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It doesn't take too long for Silence Suzuka to return from her room, but she seems a little down about losing some running time.
